V01.name: Replace target content at fixed length

V02.name: Replace irrelevant context at fixed length

V03.name: Extend the prefix before the left boundary

V05.name: Reduce an atomic target to one character

S01.name: Insert a competing field or marked block
expectations: Invariance when the reference output is unchanged

exclude_inputs: every original source input for the same task

nonselected_dimensions.Schema: single-string input and output interface remains fixed
nonselected_dimensions.Representation: no equivalence-preserving encoding operator selected for this first suite

range_reference: minimum and maximum of the named ordered attribute across exactly two synthesis examples
prefix_length_definition: selected span start, minus the longest protected literal ending immediately at that start, or minus zero if none
content_mutation_policy: change only unprotected ASCII alphanumeric runs, preserve case class, literal occurrences and punctuation/whitespace skeleton
length_mutation_policy: extend one existing run without adding fields, use max(M+1, ceil(factor*M)) for M=max attribute in demonstrations
boundary_mutation_policy: one ASCII alphanumeric character, only for an entirely unprotected atomic alphanumeric target
structure_policy: one extra delimiter field for simple selectors, one complete marked block for after[/last]+before, optional trailing trim
unsupported_structure_templates: unselected coverage, not a claim that structural changes are contract-invalid

primary_analysis.weighting: equal weight per applicable task within each profile cell

secondary_analysis.definition: all selected systems pass every source-held-out case
secondary_analysis.purpose: describe weaknesses missed by the existing held-out suite

evaluation_protocol.runtimes: pinned runtime images and frozen program manifest, verify hashes before execution
evaluation_protocol.execution: one fresh container per program, sequential single-input requests, no expected outputs sent to candidate
evaluation_protocol.deduplication: execute each task/input once per system, reuse output for all linked assertions
evaluation_protocol.exact_output: literal string equality, no normalization or trimming
evaluation_protocol.relations: evaluate separately on actual base and variant outputs, additionally report whether both are exact
evaluation_protocol.equivariance_replace_slice: apply the stored slice replacement to actual base output, fail relation if slice bounds exceed that output
evaluation_protocol.wrong_equal_outputs: can pass Invariance, cannot pass Exact Output, never interpret relation-only pass as correctness
evaluation_protocol.candidate_error_timeout_or_nonstring: failed behavioral assertion with separate outcome category
evaluation_protocol.integration_failure_or_oracle_conflict: unresolved, do not count as candidate failure or silently exclude from denominators
evaluation_protocol.coverage: planned, executed, unresolved, unselected and operator-inapplicable reported separately
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: within task/cell deduplicate exact assertions by case and relation assertions by base/case/relation, then macro-average tasks
evaluation_protocol.overlapping_cells: report cell denominators, never add cells as if inputs were disjoint
evaluation_protocol.comparisons: paired per-task system differences on identical applicable cells, report source and fit/scope strata
evaluation_protocol.headline: profile by operator and Dimension x regime-family/value x Expectation, any-failure task counts alongside baseline
evaluation_protocol.no_random_control_claim: no conclusion that targeted tests outperform an equal-size random suite
evaluation_protocol.generalization: descriptive findings for this selected corpus and study contract, no population-level or causal synthesizer-group claim
